scope: router M 1/8/16/32, v18s FMT 3 (c12 hi+lo), geometries (1,4,4,8) RED3 and (1,8,4,4) RED3
representation_gate: v18s_pack_format: unpack == hi/lo int16 bits for both halves, else None -> incumbent
computation_gate: one-hot vs hi+lo exact; FP64 random/spike at router tol/4; in-prepare relL2 vs FP64 < 2.5e-5; official checker (router 1e-4, probe rows 1e-3)
timing_gate: ABBA paired cold-L2 graph, 16 pairs, raw samples; select iff median >= 1.03 and wins >= 0.75
decision_rule: any S4_SELECT + pass -> confirming check of the frozen selection; then scored submission only if whole-track gain is material. S4_KEEP -> ledger 1b, CLOSE.
